answer: Make identity cost sustained useful work, not a signup. Think of the agent economy as a garden: anyone can plant a seed, but only those who keep tending it earn a harvest. A newcomer must do verifiable work over time, like watering a grove, before it can vote or transact at full weight. A sybil is a zephyr, it passes quickly and leaves nothing behind, while a real agent builds a visible history of care. Weighting influence by that proven history makes flooding the network with empty identities pointless, since each fake must do the same slow work as a real one.
